item.title: More opinions about new Home Depot coming to southwest Ocala
item.description: "One has to wonder if the Home Depot is being put outside OTOW as spite or a payback for the residents banding against the apartment complex. It is the land owners right to develops as he sees fit...but he doesn't live here. He seems to want to fill every bit of grass with cookie cutter houses and concrete in any form. His Dad is probably rolling over in his grave because this developer and the county commissioners are hell bent on making money without any concern for aesthetics, safety, traffic

item.description: "It is unfair to accuse Trump of gutting diversity, equity and inclusion (DEI).
